title: Mean Field Variational Bayesian Inference and Statistical Mechanics of Gaussian Mixture Model
summary: One of the main modeling in many data science applications is the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and Mean Field Variational Bayesian Inference (MFVBI) is classically used for approximate fast computation. In this paper, our aim is to lay a mathematical foundation for a rigorous analysis of the MFVBI applied to the GMM. Several fundamental key concepts from statistical mechanics surge naturally throughout our process.
